descriptionChirho: Verbal adjective describing one who trembles, quakes, or is in a state of fear and reverent awe; used of physical trembling from terror in battle (Judg 7:3; 1 Sam 4:13), reverent trembling before God's word (Isa 66:2, 5; Ezra 10:3), and anxious shaking in the face of danger; all clusters represent the same adjectival sense with varying inflectional prefixes (conjunctions, articles, prepositions) that do not change the core meaning.
